CSK Vs DC IPL 2026 Highlights (Chennai Super Kings vs Delhi Capitals Scorecard): Chennai Super Kings posted their first win of the season with a 23-run triumph over Delhi Capitals at the MA Chidambaram Stadium on Saturday riding on a Sanju Samson century. CSK posted a total of 212 as Samson starred with an unbeaten 115-run knock, while Ayush Mhatre added 59 runs before retiring hurt as the Chennai batting order fired. Jamie Overton starred with the ball for the hosts with a four-wicket haul, while Anshul Kamboj supported him with a fine three-fer of his own. Sent in to bat, Samson hit four sixes and 15 fours, adding 62 with Ruturaj Gaikwad (15), 113 with Ayush Mhatre (59) and an unbroken 37 with Shivam Dube (20) to post 212 for 2. DC replied with 189, despite Pathum Nissanka’s 41 and Tristan Stubbs’ 60. Jamie Overton took 4 for 18, Anshul Kamboj 3 for 35. CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: CSK Beat DC!Chennai Super Kings secured their first win of the season with a 23-run victory over Delhi Capitals at the MA Chidambaram Stadium on Saturday, powered by a century from Sanju Samson. CSK put up a total of 212, with Samson anchoring the innings with an unbeaten 115, while Ayush Mhatre contributed 59 runs before retiring hurt as the Chennai batting line-up clicked. With the ball, Jamie Overton led the way for the hosts with a four-wicket haul, and Anshul Kamboj backed him up with an impressive three-wicket spell. Tristan Stubbs’ half-century and Pathum Nissanka’s 41 proved insufficient as CSK bowled DC out for 189 in 20 overs. CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: CSK Beat DC!CSK Beat DC by 23 runs! Chennai get off the mark in the campaign with their emphatic win over the touring Delhi side! It all ends up for Delhi as they succumb to their second straight defeat of the season after an incredible start. Joy for Chennai as they log their first points of the campaign. Ton for Sanju, half-century for Ayush. Four-fer for Overton and three-fer for Anshul! A complete showing! DC 189 in 20 Overs! CSK 212/2 in 20 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Nine-down!Kuldeep Yadav falls to Anshul Kamboj! Chennai close in on their first win of the season as the Delhi spinner falls to the Chennai pacer. Brevis with another catch! One wicket and CSK log points! DC 185/9 in 19.1 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Four-fer for Overton!WICKET! Tristan Stubbs falls to Jamie Overton! Fourth wicket for Overton! The South African falls and dashed are Delhi’s hopes of a win on the road here! DC 183/8 in 18.3 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Stubbs fifty!Tristan Stubbs brings up his half-century to keep DC hopes alive! The South African all-rounder will have to bat through the innings to keep the visitors from crash ion out in the final stages of the game. DC 171/7 in 17 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Overton three-fer!WICKET! Aquib Nabi falls to Jamie Overton! Three-fer for the Englishman, who has taken the bowling responsibility on himself, what a season this fella is having! DC 154/6 in 15.4 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: SIX-DOWN!Ashutosh Sharma falls to Noor Ahmed! More joy for CSK here as Noor picks up his first wicket of the day! Anshul Kamboj picks up the catch to reduce DC to their final four wickets! DC 149/6 in 14.5 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Ashutosh-Stubbs at the crease!Ashutosh Sharma and Tristan Stubbs, possibly the last recognised batting pair in Delhi’s disposal look to rescue the Capital City side from the pit they find themselves in. One boundary off Gurjanpreet’s over as Stubbs Knicks one to the ropes with a bit of fortune working his way. Delhi are gonna need all the luck they can get in the chase! DC 138/5 in 14 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: CASTLED!WICKET! David Miller falls to Jamie Overton! Overton, you beauty! What a Jaffa from the Englishman as he breaks through the South African’s defence to clip the bail and light the stump up! The stadium follows suit as Delhi plunge deeper into trouble. Ashutosh Sharma, the new man in! DC 121/5 in 12.2 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Stubbs' turn!Khaleel is brought back into the attack as the Delhi batter rotate strike before getting a measure of the pacer as Stubbs knocks one into the crowd for a maximum off the pacer! Comparison charts do not show a lot of disparity between the sides at identical stages of their respective innings. Got a game and a half on our hands here! DC 121/4 in 12 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Miller gets his eye inMiller showing what he is capable of with a massive SIX over cow corne, before he muscles Noor Ahmed down the ground for a FOUR to close out the Afghani’s over! DC 106/4 in 11 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: CSK Pole!Midway point in the game and CSK have the edge now! Four quicks wickets in a matter of minutes and Delhi look vulnerable. However, the potent Protea pairing in the middle has the ability to turn any game around! They’d have to bide their time this time around though! DC 91/4 in 10 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Steady now!Delhi look to stabilise the fall of wickets as Tristan Stubbs and David Miller get their foot in! Chepauk is buzzing here in trademark fashion, after a while nevertheless. Rutu and Co. in charge at the moment! They’d have to ensure this one doesn’t slip away. DC 82/4 in 9 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Turned on its head!Sameer Rizvi falls to Jamie Overton! The old Chennai falls to send the Chepauk into an eruption. Brevis the fielder as the Protea star makes no mistake in collecting the ball with safe hands well ahead of the ropes. DC 76/4 in 8 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Turned on its head!WICKET! Axar Patel falls to Gurjanpreet! What a catch by Sarfaraz! What a way to introduce yourself, young bowler! Wicket off the first delivery. And Sarfaraz! Well, what do you call that. Stunner, absolute stunner to get rid of the opposition skipper! Chennai bouncing here! DC 66/3 in 6.1 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Double home joy!Pathum Nissanka falls to Anshul Kamboj! The Sri Lankan looked to ride a charm as Khaleel Ahmed drops the opener off Anshul’s first delivery, but his joy is lived short as the Indian pacer picks up his man off the very next ball. Returning South African Dewal Brevis completes the formality of the catch, and joy now for Chennai! DC 61/2 in 5.2 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Rahul falls!Noor Ahmed! What an effort, young man! The Afghani prevents a certain boundary with a brilliant bit of work around the ropes. Stuff that can lift a side truly this! And CSK are rewarded as Rahul throws his wicket away. Khaleel the bowler, Overton the fielder to picks his catch up! CSK 61/1 in 5 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Fifty-up!Fifty-up! KL Rahul, Pathum Nissanka bring up the fifty-run milestone for the visitors! The Delhi Capitals are turning it on here in Chennai as the veteran and the youngster go pound for pound in their pursuit of the target! DC 52/0 in 4 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Hosein continues, so do DC!Rahul seems in fine touch, continued from where he left off last time around, with a couple of boundaries, a four and a six to follow off Akeal Hosein as CSK opt to return to the Windies star with the ball. DC en route! DC 36/0 in 3 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Khaleel from the other end!Khaleel Ahmed comes in to bowl from the other end and is cut away by Sri Lankan Nissanka off a short of length delivery. The batter does it again to take the seamer to the ropes to answer the asking rate a bit. DC 24/0 in 2 Overs! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Oh, Akeal!Hosein begin in the most unironic manner possible as he starts with a no-ball and leaks a boundary on free hit as Nissanka capitalises on the chance. The batters change strike and Hosein repeats his error to give away another free hit, this time to Rahul, who picks up a double on the ball that won’t count before doting the subsequent legal one. Not for a lack of trying though as Hosein keeps it to 8 in his over despite the freebies! DC 8/0 in 1 Over! CSK vs DC IPL 2026 Match Today Live score: Delhi begin chase!First ball of the chase! KL Rahul, Pathum Nissanka open the chase for DC! Akeal Hosein with the new ball for CSK! CSK 212/2 in 20 Overs! Akeal Hosein comes in as CSK’s impact sub in place of Mhatre! Karthik Sharma will keep wickets today. A bit of a relaxation period for the centurion.
